# Medido

> Independent second opinion on what businesses pay for marketing: reads a site from outside, verifies measurement, and delivers a written diagnosis. Flat fee, accounts in the client's name.

Website in English (https://marketingmedido.com/), Hebrew (https://marketingmedido.com/he/) and Spanish (https://marketingmedido.com/es/). The text below is taken from the English site, where Medido writes in the first person.

Home page: "A second opinion on what you pay for marketing. Before you renew with your agency, read what you actually have." I don't run your ads and my fee is flat, never a percentage of what you spend. Paste your website: in under a minute you'll see what I can verify from outside, what I can't, and how to check each thing yourself.

## The free reading

- What a reading is: I read your home page from outside and write down which measurement tags it loads: Google Analytics, Tag Manager, the Meta pixel, ad tags and others. On each reading I test one WhatsApp, one phone and one email link on the home page and count what they send. My reading doesn't send visits or conversions to Google Analytics, Meta, Google Ads or Clarity. I write down what I see, and that is my evidence. I read the public domain registry, the robots file, the sitemap and the structured data. I don't log in and I don't submit any form.
- The seals: Verified: confirmed in this run, on the date and time shown on the reading. Inferred: my conclusion from what I saw, still to be confirmed. Not seen: I didn't see it in this run, which is never the same as "it doesn't exist."
- What it can't see: Who administers your accounts, what you spent, what the platform ultimately counts as a conversion, whether Google indexed a page, which sales call actually closed and who signed, and what an AI assistant says about you. Those need your accounts or repeated questions, and I say so.
- A reading is automatic and has no human review, so it can be wrong.

## Steps and published prices

My fee is flat, never a percentage of what you spend, and I don't run your ads. Prices are in US dollars, with the minimum spend that makes each step worth it. Below that, the free reading and the questions for your agency are the honest answer.

- Reading: Free. Facts about your site with a seal, what I couldn't see, and how to check each one. No signup. Fits: Any spend.
- Second reading: US$5 with your coupon (Hebrew site: 15 ILS plus VAT). Your first reading comes with a coupon: after you make the changes, get a new reading of your site for US$5 and see what was fixed, what stayed the same, what is new, and what I still can't see or verify. Fits: Any spend.
- Reading session: US$160 · with a written note US$190 (Hebrew site: 500 ILS / 600 ILS plus VAT). The report can be hard to read, and that is normal. So I offer 45 minutes with me to go through your reading, explain the findings and map out the first steps. You choose: the conversation only, or the conversation plus a written note that guides each step. Fully credited against the Diagnosis if you continue within 14 days. Fits: Any spend.
- Diagnosis: US$925 (Hebrew site: 2,900 ILS plus VAT). What is wrong today, and is it worth what you pay? A snapshot of your last quarter, delivered once, in 10 business days: a written report and a 45-minute call. Page 1 is a verdict about your agency or provider: Keep, Change or Stop. Then what is measured wrong, where budget is misplaced, who owns what, and what to ask for. It includes a Second reading after you make the fixes. Fits: From about US$1k a month, when something changes.
- Watch: US$150 a month (Hebrew site: 470 ILS a month plus VAT). Every week I re-read your site and write only when something really changes: a tag disappears, an event doubles, a domain nears expiration. One number and one decision a month. Fits: Any spend.
- Quarter: US$1,920 a month (Hebrew site: 6,000 ILS a month plus VAT). For those who will act on it and want someone checking, every month, that the money goes where it should. Month-to-month, first month on signing. Month 1 builds the base. Months 2 and 3 focus on decisions about your budget: written recommendations for your team, a check that each one was done and is being measured, a weekly page, a monthly call. If you already paid for the Diagnosis, it is deducted from month 1 if you continue within 14 days. Fits: From about US$15k a month, or if you want to scale.

## Questions

- What is Medido? Medido (marketingmedido.com) is an independent second opinion for businesses that pay for ads. It checks whether what Google Analytics, Tag Manager, Google Ads and Meta report is true. It starts with a free reading of your site, with no signup. Medido doesn't run ads, charges a flat fee, never a percentage of ad spend, and your accounts stay in your name.
- How much does Medido cost? Medido publishes its prices in US dollars, flat, never a percentage of ad spend. The reading is free. A Second reading is US$5 with the coupon from your first one. A 45-minute Reading session is US$160, or US$190 with a written note. The Diagnosis is US$925, delivered in 10 business days, half to start and half on delivery. The Watch is US$150 a month and the Quarter US$1,920 a month.
- What does Medido's free reading check? Medido's free reading looks at your home page from outside, with no signup. It shows which measurement tags load (Google Analytics, Tag Manager, the Meta pixel, ad tags), whether an event counts twice, what your WhatsApp, phone and email links send, and who holds your domain. Each finding says how sure it is and how to check it yourself, plus what it couldn't see.
- At what ad spend does each Medido service make sense? Medido publishes a minimum monthly ad spend for each step. The free reading, the Second reading (US$5), the 45-minute Reading session and the Watch (US$150 a month) fit any spend. The Diagnosis (US$925) makes sense from about US$1k a month in ads, when something changes. The Quarter (US$1,920 a month) fits from about US$15k a month, or if you want to scale.
- Do you run my ads? No. I don't run your ads, I don't replace your agency and I don't direct it either: I measure, I explain, and you decide. My fee is flat, never a percentage of what you spend, and your accounts stay in your name. I do sell follow-up services, the Watch (US$150 a month) and the Quarter (US$1,920 a month), so judge my verdict by the evidence I show.
- Who owns the accounts? You, from day one. Ads, analytics, domain and social accounts stay in your name; you can leave whenever you want and lose nothing.
- Is the work subcontracted? No. I do the work. I use software to read and draft, I check what I send, and I am responsible for it.
- What do you keep of my site? Not the page. For 30 days, a short technical record (tracking IDs, event counts, the domain's expiration date) so I can tell you what changed, the reading as shown on the page, also 30 days, for its link; and with no time limit the site's address, the dates and the coupon, so that each site gets only one free reading. To have it deleted, write to me through the contact form. My reader is called MedidoLupa. To keep it off your site, write to me.
- Why in writing? Because it leaves a record you can forward to your agency or your accountant, and you aren't tied to my calendar.
- What do you need from me? For the reading, only your website. For the Diagnosis, once the first half is paid, read-only access through Connect Google to your Google Analytics, Tag Manager and, if you allow it, Search Console (no passwords); it includes a 45-minute call. It doesn't read Google Ads or Meta: I judge those from outside and from your agency's reports.
